groups.note: E44 の「故郷でも毎週教会に通っていた」と E45 の「Pentecostal」は英語だけ
diff: The Korean original calls it simply the Seobinggo Church (English edition: “Seobinggo Pentecostal Church”).

groups.note: 食い違い: 李奇完の亡くなった歳を韓国語は「여든이 넘어（80を過ぎて）」、E69 は「at age eighty」とする
diff: The Korean original says she died past the age of eighty (English edition: “at age eighty”).

groups.note: E74 の「Japanese colonial police」は英語だけ
食い違い: E84 はアイスケーキ「두 개（2つ）」を「some flavored ice」とする
diff: The Korean original says two pieces of bread and two ice pops, one jeon each (English edition: “two pieces of bread and some flavored ice”).
